item.description: The AnycastIpList class is referenced in tests but not implemented in the cloudfront module. Tests expect this class to be available but it's currently missing, causing ImportError.
item.contract: Implement the AnycastIpList class in the cloudfront.py module with proper AWS resource properties and validation to match the test expectations.

item.description: The DBInstance validation logic in the validate method doesn't correctly implement the required credential validation logic. It needs to properly validate that either MasterUsername and either MasterUserPassword or ManageMasterUserPassword is provided, or DBSnapshotIdentifier is provided.
item.contract: Modify the DBInstance.validate method to properly implement the credential validation logic according to AWS RDS requirements, ensuring it raises appropriate ValueError messages that match test expectations.

item.description: The Template.__eq__ method needs refinement to properly compare Template objects. The current implementation doesn't handle comparison correctly with other objects like TypeComparator.
item.contract: Refine the Template.__eq__ method to properly compare Template objects and handle comparisons with other types like TypeComparator as expected by the test.

item.description: The SecurityGroup class lacks a __hash__ method implementation, causing TypeError when trying to hash SecurityGroup objects as tested in test_basic.py.
item.contract: Add a __hash__ method to the SecurityGroup class (or the base AWSObject class) to enable hashing of SecurityGroup instances as required by the test.

item.description: The parameter validation logic in the Parameter class doesn't correctly handle AllowedPattern validation for CommaDelimitedList type parameters, causing ValueError when it should be allowed.
item.contract: Modify the Parameter.validate method to allow AllowedPattern to be used with CommaDelimitedList type parameters, as per AWS CloudFormation specifications.
